Candidate 1 (from prior steps)
- Title: Project Management Specialization
- Provider: University of Colorado Boulder
- Level: Beginner
- Estimated duration: ~11 weeks
- Rating: Not re-verified this step, but previously noted as a well-rated beginner specialization.

- Provider: Google (Google Career Certificates)
- Rating: 4.9/5 (101,891 reviews; 88.22% 5-star, 10.29% 4-star; 99% of learners liked this course).

- Estimated duration: 1 week at 10 hours/week (flexible schedule).
- Main skills taught (from “Skills you’ll gain”): Organizational Change, Change Management, Project Planning, Organizational Structure, Project Management Life Cycle, Strategic Thinking, Program Management, AI Enablement, Project Management.

- Provider:
  - Candidate 1: University of Colorado Boulder (university specialization).
  - Candidate 2: Google (industry provider via Google Career Certificates).

  - Candidate 1: Well-rated (exact score not rechecked this step but previously captured as strong).
  - Candidate 2: Very strong rating (4.9/5 based on 101,891 reviews) with 99% of learners liking the course.
- Duration:
  - Candidate 1: ~11 weeks.
  - Candidate 2: 1 week at 10 hours/week.
- Level:
  - Candidate 1: Beginner.
  - Candidate 2: Beginner; explicitly states “No prior experience required.”
- Main skills focus:
  - Candidate 1: Emphasis on the broader project-management toolkit and team/leadership skills—Scrum, sprint planning, project scoping, engineering and team management, risk and scope management, stakeholder communications.
  - Candidate 2: Foundational understanding of project management practice—project planning, project management life cycle, organizational structure and culture, change management, strategic thinking, program management, AI enablement.

Recommendation (shorter well-rated option, without enrolling)
- Both options are beginner-friendly and well rated, but the Google “Foundations of Project Management” course is dramatically shorter (1 week vs. ~11 weeks) while still carrying an excellent rating (4.9/5 with a very high volume of reviews and 99% learner satisfaction).
- For a beginner seeking a shorter, well-rated introduction to project management, the recommended choice is:
  - Foundations of Project Management (Google)
  - Justification: 
    - Short duration (1 week at ~10 hours) makes it easier to complete quickly.
    - Extremely strong, well-validated rating with many reviews.
    - Clearly targeted at true beginners with no prior experience and covers essential foundational concepts and skills (project management life cycle, planning, organizational structure/culture, change management, and core PM skills).

You can consider the University of Colorado Boulder specialization later if you want a longer, more in-depth multi-course sequence, but as a first, short, well-rated step, the Google Foundations of Project Management course is the better fit.
